name: global-film-festival-2025
description: Web application for Global Film Festival 2025 - an international short film competition

scripts.build: rimraf dist && mkdir dist && npm run build:html && npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:assets
scripts.zip: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const archiver=require('archiver');const output=fs.createWriteStream('global-film-festival-2025-build.zip');const archive=archiver('zip');output.on('close',function(){console.log('Archive created: '+archive.pointer()+' total bytes');console.log('Archive has been finalized and the output file descriptor has been closed.');});archive.on('error',function(err){throw err;});archive.pipe(output);archive.directory('dist/',false);archive.finalize();"
scripts.build:zip: npm run build && npm run zip

author: Global Film Festival 2025
